message.content: Jareth expresses his admiration for the storytelling in side quests in the game "The Witcher 3." He highlights the game's ability to feature quests that feel significant to the overall storyline, with each NPC having their own backstory and feelings. This approach to side quests makes them appear vital to the narrative, enhancing the player's immersion and emotional connection to the game. Rowan also confirms the emotional impact of the character's side quests in the same game, noting that they hit hard and make the player reflect on the consequences of their decisions. Both Jareth and Rowan point out that the side quests in "The Witcher 3" enrich the game's narrative by adding another layer of depth and engagement.
